async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Click on the Orders link under the Reports menu to navigate to the Orders report page
    # Based on the accessibility tree, the Orders link is within nested menus under the menubar
    orders_link = page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("menu").get_by_role("menu").get_by_role("link", name="Orders")
    await orders_link.click()
    # Wait for the page to load after navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Additional wait to ensure UI is ready
    
    # Now on the Orders report page, set the date range from May 1, 2021 to March 31, 2022
    # Look for date input fields; they might be textboxes with labels or specific roles
    # Assuming there are two date fields for 'From' and 'To'
    # Use get_by_role with name or get_by_label if available; from the tree, I don't see specific labels, so I'll use get_by_role with approximate names
    # I'll try to find elements with role 'textbox' and fill them based on context
    # Alternatively, use page.locator with CSS selectors if roles are not clear, but I'll stick to roles as per instructions
    # Since the exact roles aren't specified in the current tree, I'll assume common patterns in Magento Admin
    # I'll set the date in format likely 'MM/DD/YYYY' or similar
    from_date = "05/01/2021"
    to_date = "03/31/2022"
    
    # Try to fill the 'From' date field
    from_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="From")
    await from_field.fill(from_date)
    
    # Try to fill the 'To' date field
    to_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="To")
    await to_field.fill(to_date)
    
    # Look for a button to generate the report, e.g., 'Refresh' or 'Show Report'
    # Based on common UI, there might be a button with name 'Refresh' or 'Submit'
    generate_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Refresh")
    await generate_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the report to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(3)  # Allow time for report generation
    
    # After generating, the report should be displayed; task is to create it, so I can consider it done
    # No further actions needed
